scene.title: TicketFlow ships to production, and monitoring catches a retry loop before it pages
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 13

TicketFlow ships to production. You deploy on BYOC (your AWS account) to meet data residency requirements. You set up token tracking by feature, error categorization (429 → warn, auth failure → page on-call), and CI/CD with automated evals. Monitoring catches a spike in 429s; you discover a retry loop bug and fix it before it pages.

takeaways: Data residency requirement → BYOC (your AWS/GCP account); ship fast with low ops overhead → Anthropic-hosted. Compliance cannot be bypassed.
Route errors by impact: 429, timeouts and 500/503 are warnings to retry with backoff; AuthenticationError (401) is critical, page on-call.
CI/CD for Claude apps: linting, unit tests, integration tests with mock responses, evals on representative inputs, and security scans.
Model migration: run evals on the new model, adjust prompts for format drift, roll out behind a feature flag, keep instant rollback.
